lead_raw_text:
The structure of PrAgBi₂ is cubic, space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with 16 atoms in the unit cell and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all three elements in eight-coordinate, body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements, with Ag and Pr each surrounded by eight Bi neighbors at 3.329 Å and Bi by four Ag and four Pr neighbors at the same distance. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Bi-centered 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Ag- and Pr-centered polyhedra.
